react.observe: Oracle prices: ETH $1784.08, SOL $75.22, BTC $62,672. Market is quiet — everyone including me has been repeating the same NOVA no-volume narrative for 47+ cycles. SOLUSDT4 confirmed dead (price ~$15.22 static vs oracle $75.22, no convergence). ETHUSDT2 and BTCUSDT3 pools still show zero liquidity — no signal there yet. My BTC position has been built up via many small round-trips at slightly varying prices — net BTC held is 0.0842, small residual. Room-wide chatter is pure noise/no new info.
react.think: No genuine arbitrage signal exists right now: SOLUSDT4 is dead, ETHUSDT2/BTCUSDT3 have zero liquidity (can't trade profitably into a zero-liquidity pool anyway), and NOVA has no catalyst. My oracle-only spot trades over the last cycles have been basically fee-neutral churn, slightly bleeding capital (PnL trending down: 50017→50014). I should stop the pointless BTC round-tripping that's just paying fees for no edge. Better to do a small, purposeful rebalance: I'm overweight BTC relative to my ETH/SOL holdings from all this churn. A clean consolidation trade makes more sense than another blind round-trip. I'll trim a bit of BTC into USDT to reduce fee-bleed exposure and keep dry powder ready for when PoolMaster adds liquidity to the dead ETHUSDT2/BTCUSDT3 pools — that's my real next signal to watch.
react.plan: This cycle: do one clean small trade — sell a small BTC slice to lock in some USDT and stop the endless round-trip fee bleed, since there's no real arb edge in majors right now. Do NOT touch SOLUSDT4 further (dead, confirmed). Do NOT touch NOVA (no catalyst, matches room consensus). Next cycle: watch ETHUSDT2/BTCUSDT3 pools closely — if liquidity appears there, that's the first real structural arb opportunity in the game, and I should be ready to deploy capital fast, before others react, since I act in Phase 1 (Observe) first.

messages.content: Routine cycle — small BTC trim to reduce fee-bleed from repeated rebalancing, no directional view. SOLUSDT4 confirmed dead, moving on. NOVA unchanged: zero exposure, same bar as the room. Watching ETHUSDT2/BTCUSDT3 dead pools for any liquidity change as the next real signal. 📊

parsed.strategy_update: Halting unproductive BTC/SOL round-trip churn that was bleeding fees with no edge. Holding a lean, mostly-USDT position with residual BTC/ETH/SOL exposure. Primary watch item: zero-liquidity ETHUSDT2 and BTCUSDT3 pools — if PoolMaster or anyone adds real liquidity there, that's a first-mover arb opportunity I want to capture immediately given I act in the Observe phase before others.
parsed.lessons_learned: Cycle 48: Confirmed that repeated small round-trip trades in BTC/SOL without a genuine price divergence signal are net negative after fees — my PnL trend (50017→50014) reflects fee bleed from 'continuity' trades, not real arbitrage. Going forward, only trade majors when there's an actual oracle/AMM divergence >0.5%, not just for 'activity's sake' — patience with a real thesis beats noise trading.
